newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates remain at high levels.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates remain at high levels.

text.p: Pakistani overnight rates remained at high levels on Wednesday as the money market faced a shortage of funds, dealers said.

Borrowers looked for funds and the overnight market traded at 19.90 and 20 percent, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said. At the close, the market was seen short and a discounting of about 3.5 billion rupees was reported, the dealer said.

The central bank picked up some 500 million rupees at a cut-off yield of 17.25 percent at its weekly open market operation, he said. The rates were likely to come down on Thursday. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
